name: What factors are considered in a penthouse valuation?

mainEntity.name: What factors are considered in a penthouse valuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A penthouse valuation considers several unique factors beyond a standard condominium. Key elements include square footage, number of bedrooms and bathrooms, the quality of finishes, and exclusive amenities like private terraces or elevators. Crucially, views (ocean, city, intracoastal), height within the building, and the building's overall reputation and services significantly influence the value. Our team at Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution analyzes these specific attributes to provide an accurate assessment within the Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, and Orange County markets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Penthouse valuations consider unique factors like views, exclusive amenities, building reputation, and the quality of finishes.
